question: Which of the following is the correct spelling of the word?
solution:
The correct answer is **option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **'Aesthetic.'**
 
• **'Aesthetic'** is an adjective that means 'concerned with beauty or the appreciation of beauty.' **(सौंदर्य संबंधी)**
 
• **For Example -** The design of the building is highly aesthetic.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Easthetic:** Incorrect spelling.
 
• **Aesthatic:** Incorrect spelling.
 
• **Aesthettic:** Incorrect spelling.
